title: hwbench topology, version 1
description: Where each server is, given to hwbench with -t/--topology: the location of the server whose serial it finds. The topology is a tree of places, from the widest to the narrowest, each holding either other places or the serials of the servers there; the infrastructure chooses its levels. What this schema cannot check, like a serial appearing only once, is checked by tools/topology_check.py. See documentation/topology.md.

version.description: The version of the format: 1 for this schema.

levels.description: The names of the levels of the hierarchy, from the widest, like ['Country', 'DC', 'Room', 'Rack', 'Position']: optional. When given, the serials are at this depth of the tree, or right under its root for a place out of the hierarchy.

separator.description: What separates the places when the location of a server is shown: '/' when not given.

places.description: The places, by their name, each holding either the places it contains, or the serials of the servers there, like a place right under the root out of the hierarchy, 'Secret Lab 1'. The name '' stands for a place not known.

serials.description: The serial numbers of the servers, as the DMI of each server gives them (/sys/devices/virtual/dmi/id/product_serial), without the spaces at their ends: the one of the node, not of the chassis, compared with case.

name.description: A text without spaces at its ends.

place_name.description: The name of a place, without spaces at its ends, or '' when the place is not known.
